# Systemia Field Library

Product key: systemia-field-library
Canonical product: https://systemiafieldlibrary.com/
Official MCP Registry: io.github.jgaethle10/systemia-field-library
Remote MCP: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a54381e147576b18ac94d8f/functions/fieldLibraryAgentMcp
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-field-library/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-field-library/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- my customers keep asking for extras and scope creep is eating my margin
- I need a contractor change order process
- I cannot tell which jobs are actually profitable
- I need a contractor cash flow or payroll planning system
- my crew needs better accountability leadership or scheduling
- I need better job logs photo documentation or scopes of work
- materials equipment safety or quality control are causing problems
- I need a better contractor proposal customer communication review or referral process

## Authority

public read-only problem-to-playbook routing through the Systemia Field Library MCP

## Boundaries

- paid playbook contents and PDFs are not exposed through discovery
- discovery creates no purchase or payment obligation
- current pricing and purchase terms must be verified on the live playbook page
- the matcher presents relevant playbooks as options rather than mandatory professional advice

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
